name: Noreflow
author: Noreflow

sections.description:
Noreflow is a customer messaging platform for businesses in the Gulf. Its assistant, Nori, answers your customers in Arabic and English on your website chat, Telegram, TikTok and email, using your own products, prices and order status, and hands the conversation to your team when needed. WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger are coming soon.

This plugin connects your WooCommerce store to your Noreflow account:

  • Connect in one step. Press “Connect to Noreflow”, sign in, and approve read-only access on your own site.
  • Read only. Noreflow reads your products and orders. Nothing in your store is changed.
  • Order status in the chat. When a customer asks “where is my order?”, Nori answers from the order itself.
  • WhatsApp chat button. Optionally show a WhatsApp button on every page of your store. It is a plain link to your own WhatsApp number; no script is loaded, and the messages go to your WhatsApp, not to Noreflow.

A Noreflow account is needed to use the connection. The WhatsApp button works without one.

External services

This plugin connects your store to Noreflow (https://noreflow.net), a service run by NOREFLOW LTD.

  • When you press “Connect to Noreflow”, your browser opens noreflow.net with your store’s address, so the connection can be set up for your account.
  • When you approve, WooCommerce creates read-only REST API keys and sends them to noreflow.net. Noreflow then reads your products, orders and store settings (name, currency) through the WooCommerce REST API to answer your customers. Order data includes the customer’s name, phone, email, items and status.
  • The WhatsApp button links to wa.me (WhatsApp, run by Meta) with your number when a visitor clicks it. Nothing is sent before a click.

Noreflow terms of service: https://noreflow.net/terms
Noreflow privacy policy: https://noreflow.net/privacy
WhatsApp terms: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be active.
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Noreflow.
  3. Press “Connect to Noreflow”, sign in or create an account, then approve the access on your store.
  4. Optional: enter your WhatsApp number and turn on the chat button.
sections.faq:
Does Noreflow change anything in my store?

No. The keys are read only. Noreflow reads products and orders; it does not edit them.

How do I disconnect?

Disconnect the store in Noreflow, or delete the “Noreflow” key in WooCommerce → Settings → Advanced → REST API.

How fast do new orders appear?

Noreflow checks for new orders every 15 minutes.
